HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about African Civilisations is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say African Civilisations never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations.
   C. Treat African Civilisations as rumours only.
   D. Explain African Civilisations with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya.
   C. Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

6. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha as rumours only.
   B. Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha.

7. Which statement about Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence as rumours only.
   B. Explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence.
   D. Say Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa.
   C. Treat Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   B. Say Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya.
   D. Treat Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya as rumours only.

11. Which statement about External Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing External Security.
   B. Say External Security never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain External Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat External Security as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period.
   C. Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain African Civilisations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Conflict Resolutions in Independent Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Nairobi

2. D — Plan income and spending wisely

3. D — Explain African Civilisations with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. B — Explain symbols used on a map

6. B — Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. B — Explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. D — Explain Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. D — Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. B — Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. C — Explain External Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of African Civilisations; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Conflict Resolutions in Independent Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
